name: pixel-haxe
description: Pixel Api — Hafif ve cok hedefli Haxe API mikro-framework'u. A lightweight, multi-target Haxe API micro-framework. Router, route groups, middleware, CORS, JSON, cookies, Bearer auth, rate limiting, OpenAPI docs, live metrics panel and static file serving; runs on Node.js, PHP, Neko and HashLink.
releasenote: v0.4.0: tarayici tabanli canli izleme paneli (app.panel: toplam istek, durum kodlari, en yavas yollar, bellek) ve yetki anahtari destegi. Browser-based live monitoring panel (app.panel: total requests, status codes, slowest paths, memory) with access key support.
